BadGateway.description: An external service (TMDB, Spotify, Google Books, SendGrid, or Cloudinary) failed. `msg` names the service.

InvalidToken.description: The token is invalid or expired, or its user is inactive (`"Invalid token"`). The UI logs the user out on this response.

NotFound.description: The requested user or media doesn't exist.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this IP (`"Too many requests. Please try again later."`). `RateLimit-*` headers describe the window.

ServerError.description: An unexpected error (`"Something went wrong. Please try again."`). Details are logged on the server, never returned.

TokenNotFound.description: No `Authorization` header was sent (`"Token not found"`).

ValidationError.description: The request body failed validation. `msg` describes the first problem.

isProfileComplete.description: False until the user has a userName.

accessToken.description: JWT to send as the `Authorization` header.

mediaId.description: ID in the source catalog (TMDB, Spotify, Google Books).

poster.description: Poster URL, or an empty string when TMDB has none.
Set only when Spotify has a 640px album image.

userName.description: Missing until a social sign-up completes their profile.

rating.description: The score. Stored as a string.

commentedBy.description: Null if the commenter no longer exists.

media.description: Null if the media no longer exists.

ratedBy.description: Null if the author no longer exists.

page.description: 1-based page number. Defaults to the first page.

user.description: An `AccountUser` when the caller views their own profile, otherwise a `PublicUser`.

tokenAuth.description: The JWT returned by signup/login, sent as the raw header value — no `Bearer ` prefix.
